Its loss may induce replication stress and p53 activation, but Prdx1 is primarily regulated by Nrf2 rather than p53, and no published data link Gins4 to Prdx1 expression in macrophages. Consequently, there is insufficient mechanistic evidence to predict a consistent up‑ or down‑regulation.
